visualCharacteristics: An interactive insurance simulation form with two tabs over radio-button option groups that enable step by step and a submit button. The compact variant shows a grey box of four dropdowns with a full-width submit button.
contentPattern: Row 1: [tab 1 label] [tab 2 label]. One row per field, in order gender, marital status, children, age: [label paragraph, empty to join the previous group] [options list]. Last row: [submit label paragraph] [form action link paragraph].
usage: Use it to let visitors answer a few questions and get a recommended insurance product.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it only for this recommendation form that submits to the results page; pick a form or embed block for other forms.
